findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "doctor" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, example, check_discovery_documents, llms_txt_from_sitemap · Private data: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, whoami, example, check_discovery_documents, explain_document · Public sink: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, whoami, example · Destructive: example, validate_llms_txt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, example, check_discovery_documents, llms_txt_from_sitemap · Private data: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, whoami, example, check_discovery_documents, explain_document · Public sink: no_arguments_check_this_hosts_own_discovery_documents, whoami, example · Destructive: example, validate_llms_txt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
